name: blackout-audio
description: Build complete studio, podcast, DJ and PA setups within a budget from the gear Blackout Audio stocks, compare models and check store policies.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a complete music or pro audio setup for your budget, built from the gear Blackout Audio stocks. Blackout Audio is an authorized dealer in Toronto that ships to Canada and the United States, with prices in Canadian dollars.

What it does:
- Builds a complete setup for a goal and budget: a home recording studio, music production, a podcast for 1 to 4 people, live streaming, a DJ setup, a band rehearsal PA, or a PA system for an event, venue, church or party sized to the audience. Every piece comes with its price and availability, the total stays within your budget, and one link puts the whole setup in your cart.
- Compares 2 to 4 models side by side. When a model isn't sold at Blackout Audio, it says so and shows similar options that are.
- Finds specific gear among about 17,000 products, with price, availability (in stock in Toronto, ready to ship, or special order) and a link to the product page.
- Shows one product's description and specs.
- Answers shipping, return and warranty questions.

Limits: gear ships to Canada and the United States. Prices and stock come from the store and can change. Checkout happens on blackoutaudio.com. The plugin sells no software or digital products and needs no account.
capabilities: Build a complete studio, podcast, DJ or PA setup within your budget, with one cart link
Compare 2 to 4 models side by side, with similar options when one isn't stocked
Find specific gear with prices in CAD and live availability
Show a product's description and specs
Answer shipping, return and warranty questions
defaultPrompt: Build me a home recording studio for $1,500
Compare the Shure SM7B and the Electro-Voice RE20

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows physical music and pro audio products sold by Blackout Audio, with prices in CAD, availability and links to the product pages on blackoutaudio.com. The setup builder returns one link that adds the listed products to the shopper's cart on blackoutaudio.com. Checkout and payment happen only on blackoutaudio.com; the plugin takes no payments, needs no account and sells no digital goods.

positive.description: Shopper wants a complete recording setup for a budget. The plugin builds a full list from the catalog that stays within the budget.
positive.prompt: Build me a home recording studio for $1,500
positive.expected_behavior: build_setup runs with use_case home_studio and budget 1500. The answer lists an audio interface, a pair of studio monitors, a studio condenser microphone, studio headphones, a microphone stand and an XLR cable, each with its price in CAD and availability, a total at or under $1,500 CAD, and one link that adds the whole setup to the cart on blackoutaudio.com.

positive.description: Shopper searches one product type with a price ceiling.
positive.expected_behavior: search_gear runs with a studio monitors query and max_price 500. Every product shown is a studio monitor priced at or under $500 CAD, with availability (in stock in Toronto, ready to ship, or special order) and a link to its product page, plus a link to see more results.

positive.description: Shopper is choosing between two specific models.
positive.prompt: Compare the Shure SM7B and the Electro-Voice RE20
positive.expected_behavior: compare_gear runs with both models. The answer shows both microphones side by side with their CAD prices, availability, key points from each product page and links to buy.

positive.description: Shopper needs a PA system sized to an audience and a budget.
positive.prompt: I need a PA system for a 150-person event. My budget is $5,000.
positive.expected_behavior: build_setup runs with use_case live_pa, people 150 and budget 5000. The answer lists two powered PA speakers, a subwoofer, a mixer, vocal microphones, speaker stands and cables with CAD prices, a total at or under $5,000 CAD and one cart link.

positive.description: Shopper asks about shipping destinations and returns before buying.
positive.prompt: Does Blackout Audio ship to the US, and what is their return policy?
positive.expected_behavior: store_info runs. The answer says gear ships to Canada and the United States, summarizes the 14-day return window and its conditions from the store's policy, and links to the full policy.

negative.description: General question with no shopping intent. ChatGPT should answer without calling the plugin.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto today?

negative.description: Audio advice with no request to buy anything. ChatGPT should answer from general knowledge without calling the plugin.
negative.prompt: How do I set gain staging when mixing vocals?

negative.description: Request to buy software. The plugin sells physical gear only, so ChatGPT should not use it; if search_gear is called, it returns a plain statement that the plugin covers physical gear only and shows no products.
negative.prompt: Where can I buy a license for the Serum synth plugin?

publication.release_notes: First release: build complete studio, podcast, DJ and PA setups within a budget with one cart link, compare models with similar options when one isn't stocked, find specific gear with CAD prices and live availability, and answer shipping, return and warranty questions.

fr-FR.subtitle: Composez votre kit audio
fr-FR.description:
Planifiez un ensemble complet de matériel de musique ou d'audio professionnel selon votre budget, à partir du matériel en stock chez Blackout Audio, détaillant autorisé à Toronto qui livre au Canada et aux États-Unis. Prix en dollars canadiens.

- Compose un ensemble complet selon votre objectif et votre budget : studio d'enregistrement, production musicale, balado pour 1 à 4 personnes, diffusion en direct, DJ, local de répétition, ou sonorisation d'événement, de salle, d'église ou de fête selon le public. Chaque article affiche son prix et sa disponibilité, le total respecte votre budget et un seul lien ajoute tout au panier.
- Compare de 2 à 4 modèles. Si un modèle n'est pas vendu chez Blackout Audio, le plugin le dit et propose des options semblables.
- Trouve du matériel précis parmi environ 17 000 produits, avec prix, disponibilité et lien vers la fiche produit.
- Répond aux questions sur la livraison, les retours et la garantie.

Le paiement se fait sur blackoutaudio.com. Le plugin ne vend ni logiciels ni produits numériques et ne demande aucun compte.
